summary: Sheets #34 (Real Estate/Listing Mode), #35 (Materials Exchange), #36 (Neighborhood Bulk Buying) validated E2E. Backend: 23/23 pytest passed. Frontend: all three screens load from Profile menu, testIDs match spec (profile-realestate/circular/bulk, re-share-btn, circ-tab-*, circ-title/submit, circ-green-search, bulk-add/title/price/submit, bulk-close-<id>). Cross-user flows verified (claim by pat_pro_test → owner notified; bulk join by 2nd user → 5% discount tier unlocked; leave, close by creator all pass). Public share endpoints work without auth; wrong token → 404 as expected. AI summary generated and cached.

ui_bugs.issue: For demo_home (19 Emergency-logged projects with $0 cost_cents), ai_summary correctly narrates the improvements but value_add.estimate_cents = 0 and roi_pct = 0 are displayed as '$0 · +0% vs materials invested ($0)'. Not a bug, but the AI narrative and the $0 value contradict visually. Consider suppressing the value card (or showing 'Not enough cost data') when invested_cents == 0.

action_items: OPTIONAL: When totals.invested_cents == 0 on /realestate, hide or downgrade the 'Estimated value added' hero to avoid a confusing '$0 · +0%' next to an AI narrative describing multiple repairs (realestate.tsx lines 67-72).
OPTIONAL long-term: /app/backend/server.py is 6423 lines — split into feature-level modules for maintainability (not a blocker for this iteration).

OPTIONAL: The /realestate/share endpoint mints a shared portfolio_token; toggling public=false on /portfolio/share also flips is_public on the RE report (shared state is fine, but worth documenting so users know).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2959 uses helper doc_name(user) inside dict literal that is later re-referenced; the helper is defined after create_bulk_deal (L2966). Works because Python resolves at call time, but move the helper above create_bulk_deal for clarity.
server.py close_bulk_deal (L3000-3012) returns 404 for both 'not found' and 'not the creator' — good security (doesn't leak existence), keep as-is.
server.py claim_listing self-claim rejected with 400 (L2814) as documented in the note.
